name: Doki Doki Fiendish
source:
As we all know, the second act of Doki Doki Literature Club presented us with a host of unsettling scenes. You liked it, didn’t you? You wanted it to be longer. For the horror to continue. If you’re yearning for some more shivers down your spine then you came to the right place.

Source: http://ddlcmods.com/fiendish/
translation:
众所周知，《心跳文学社》第二幕给我们呈现了一系列令人不安的场景。你喜欢它，不是吗？你希望它更长。为了让恐怖继续下去。如果你渴望更多的脊椎发抖，那么你来对地方了。

来源：http://ddlcmods.com/fiendish/
